text: Cadillac is a General Motors brand: GM's Form 10-K for 2025 says its vehicles are developed, manufactured and marketed under the Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet and GMC brands.
short: Cadillac is a General Motors brand.

source.name: General Motors Company — Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025, filed with the SEC
source.quote: with vehicles developed, manufactured, and/or marketed under the Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, and GMC brands.
